name: Didit
summary: Identity verification and fraud: KYC/KYB verification sessions and their decisions, and standalone AML screening of people and companies.

api_key.description: A Didit application API key (console, or the programmatic sign-up); sk_live_ for live, sk_test_ for sandbox. Sent in the x-api-key header.

notes: A wrong or expired key answers 401; a missing key 403.
Checks are billed per completed check from prepaid credit (full KYC $0.33, AML screening $0.20 at list price); the sandbox is free, with 500 test sessions per 24 hours per sandbox application.
Session results arrive by webhook in production; list and decision calls are for lookups, not tight polling.
Session decisions carry personal data (documents, faces, addresses): handle them as such.

endpoints.name: List verification sessions
endpoints.summary: KYC and/or KYB sessions with status, filtered by status, your user id, dates, country or free text.

vendor_data.description: Exact match on the vendor_data sent at creation (your user id).

search.description: Free text: a session reference (S-0001), UUID, name, email prefix, document number or vendor_data.

limit.description: Rows per page (per kind with session_kind=all), default 50.

offset.description: Rows to skip; prefer the next/previous URLs in the answer.

endpoints.name: Get a session's decision
endpoints.summary: The full result of one KYC or KYB session: status, ID, liveness, face match, AML, registry and OCR data.

sessionId.description: Session UUID from sessions.create or sessions.list. A malformed UUID answers a 404 HTML page.

include.description: Extra sections: events, resubmissions, or events,resubmissions.

notes: Needs the read:sessions privilege on the key.

endpoints.name: Create a verification session
endpoints.summary: Start a hosted KYC or KYB flow for a user from one of your workflows; answers with the session id and the URL to send the user to.

workflow_id.description: UUID of the console workflow that defines the checks (and whether it is KYC or KYB).

vendor_data.description: Your id for the user; groups sessions and scopes duplicate detection.

callback.description: URL to redirect the user to when done; must be on the application's allowed domains when those are set.

callback_method.description: Which device follows the callback; default initiator.

metadata.description: Your JSON, stored and echoed back; not shown to the user.

tags.description: Up to 10 tag names, each up to 50 characters.

notes: A write: creates a session and the completed checks are billed.

endpoints.name: Screen a person or company for AML
endpoints.summary: Sanctions, PEP and watchlist hits for a name, scored and settled as Approved, In Review or Declined; optional adverse media.

full_name.description: Name to screen, at least 2 characters.

document_number.description: ID document number; an exact match forces the hit score to 100.

aml_match_score_threshold.description: Per-hit cutoff 0-100, default 93; lower hits are false positives.

include_adverse_media.description: Also search negative news; adds up to ~30 s, so use a 60 s timeout.

include_ongoing_monitoring.description: Keep re-screening and report changes by webhook (billed yearly); needs save_api_request.

save_api_request.description: Default true: store the screening as a session. false for a stateless check.

vendor_data.description: Your id for the screened party.

notes: Marked a write: it is billed ($0.20 list) and by default stores a session in your account. A name under 2 characters is refused before billing.
